category.zh: 分子表示 · 可解释建模

summary.zh: 从分子结构与表面性质出发，构建化学可解释的描述符，连接特征筛选、预测建模与模型解释。
summary.en: A workflow connecting molecular structures and surface properties with chemically interpretable descriptors, feature selection, predictive modeling and model interpretation.

note.en: Email verification and administrator approval required. Shared per-user limits: 1 running task, 2 queued tasks and 10 submissions per day; private results are retained for 72 hours. Service availability depends on the research server.
note.zh: 须验证邮箱并经管理员批准。各工具共用每用户 1 项运行、2 项排队、每天 10 次提交的配额；私人结果保留 72 小时。服务可用性取决于科研服务器运行状态。

alt.en: Actual held-out mean absolute SHAP values: TPSA and molecular weight have the largest attribution magnitudes in this teaching run.
alt.zh: 实际留出样本的平均绝对 SHAP：本次教学运行中 TPSA 与分子量的影响幅度最大。

caption.en: Server run, 20 October 2026: 36 public molecules, six RDKit descriptors, computed Crippen logP. Importance is measured on eight held-out samples; inspect signed contributions in the downloadable result. This is an operation demo, not experimental validation.
caption.zh: 2026 年 10 月 20 日服务器实跑：36 个公开分子、6 个 RDKit 描述符、计算 Crippen logP。重要性来自 8 个留出样本；正负方向请结合下载结果中的带符号贡献查看。这是操作示例，不是实验验证。

note.en: Email verification and administrator approval required. Shared per-user limits: 1 running task, 2 queued tasks and 10 submissions per day; private results are retained for 72 hours. Service availability depends on the research server.

alt.en: Server-computed spectrum of an arbitrary synthetic dipole matrix; not molecular or experimental data
alt.zh: 任意合成偶极矩矩阵在服务器生成的光谱，仅为代数测试，不是分子或实验数据

caption.en: A reproducible algebra example: two supplied excited states, saved ground reference and 0.05 eV denominator damping. This tests the workflow; it is not a physical accuracy benchmark.

category.zh: 楼栋风压暴露 · 巡检规划

summary.en: A screening prototype connecting desktop building annotation and approved online direct-input calculations with wind-direction, facade and height-band comparisons.
summary.zh: 连接桌面楼栋标注与审批后在线参数计算，比较来风方向、立面和高度分段压力幅值的筛查原型。

availability.en: Approved online direct-input demo and desktop demonstrations. A public source/package release remains pending.
availability.zh: 已提供审批后直接输入的在线演示，也可联系了解桌面软件；公开源码与安装包仍待整理。

alt.en: Four-step schematic: annotate buildings, set wind scenarios, compare facade and floor-band exposure, and review exports.
alt.zh: 四步工作流示意：标注楼栋、设置风向情景、比较立面与楼层段暴露、查看并导出结果。

caption.en: Workflow schematic. Geometry is illustrative, not a map or a computed result.
caption.zh: 工作流示意图。图中几何为示意，不是真实底图或计算结果。

alt.en: Original desktop export showing a pseudo-3D building and floor-band pressure estimates as wind direction changes; the prototype interface is in Chinese.
alt.zh: 桌面软件已有导出：伪三维楼栋及不同风向下的楼层段风压估计。

caption.en: Original desktop export (Chinese interface). Values illustrate the simplified screening model; they are not validated design loads or measured damage probabilities.
caption.zh: 桌面软件原始导出。数值展示简化筛查模型的输出，不是经验证的设计荷载或实测破坏概率。

label.zh: 查看原始风向扫描动画

alt.en: Actual online three-building example: maximum pressure magnitudes across facades for the four model height bands.
alt.zh: 在线三栋合成楼示例的实际输出：四个模型高度分段的立面最大压力幅值。

caption.en: Online direct-input example, 20 October 2026. Hypothetical rectangular buildings; model-estimated nonnegative pressure magnitudes in kPa, not measured loads or calibrated safety thresholds. Colors distinguish height bands.
caption.zh: 2026 年 10 月 20 日直接输入的在线示例。使用假设的矩形楼栋，展示模型估计的非负压力幅值（kPa）；不是实测荷载或标定的安全阈值。颜色区分高度分段。
